title: PHP Conference Japan 2021 Online
content:
We are excited to announce the . 🎉 It will be 2 days online conference this year. PHP Conference Japan 2021

Unfortunately, this CfP system does not support English UI. 😢 Please use browser translation feature to submit your proposal. Sorry for the inconvenience. Submit your papers!!

🐘🐘🐘 One more thing 🐘🐘🐘 The that was held last year will be held again this year! We look forward to your contributions. Please take some selfies with your elePHPant and tweet them with hashtags below: #あなたの街のelePHPant #my_hometown_with_elePHPant #phpcon2021 #elePHPant

#あなたの街のelePHPant hashtag event

  • Conference Date : 2021/10/2 (SAT), 3 (SUN) 10:00-20:00 JST
  • Venue: Online
  • Ticket: Free
  • CFP Deadline : 2021/08/08 23:59:59 JST
